    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    t = int(input[0])
    index = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        p = input[index]
        current_jump = 1
        days = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(p):
            if p[i] == '#':
                i += 1
            else:
                gap_start = i
                while i < len(p) and p[i] == '.':
                    i += 1
                gap_length = i - gap_start
                if gap_length > current_jump:
                    current_jump = gap_length
                    days += 1
        results.append(days)
        index += 1
    for result in results:
        print(result)
